summary: I build the platform other engineers deploy through, and I own technical standards and cross-squad design, including the build-versus-buy calls. Backend and distributed systems at heart, with a TypeScript and Node home base.

impact.title: Developer platform
impact.text: Self-service feature-branch deployments on golden paths, a live Envoy edge, and a release controller built as a leader-elected, multi-replica state machine.

impact.title: Delivery
impact.text: A reusable CI/CD platform on Kubernetes that other teams adopt with almost no setup, with audit-ready repository governance and automated releases.

impact.title: Identity and APIs
impact.text: An org-wide single sign-on standard, and a versioned public API with one code generator emitting TypeScript, PHP and MCP targets.

impact.title: Standards
impact.text: The RFC and architecture-review process, a strict type-safety rule for maintained services, and mentoring across squads.

jobs.note: Promoted from Senior Full-Stack Node Engineer III, to Lead Full-Stack Node Engineer, to Software Architect.
bullets: Built the internal developer platform and graduated it from prototype to production as project lead.
Hardened rollout safety with drift reporting, scheduled health checks, failure hooks and partial-deploy recovery.
Served as release manager for a large cross-team integration rollout.
Represent engineering in vendor and partner technical engagements, and own cross-squad system design.
Introduced continuous automated testing and container image builds, and managed cloud deployments and networking.
Built a federated GraphQL service for the repair lifecycle, with role-based scopes isolating customer data.
Built an OIDC provider for internal and external single sign-on, federating the corporate directory.
Rewrote a recursive bill-of-materials builder as an iterative algorithm, ending production crashes on large lists.
Wrote deployment scripts and group-policy automation that cut server setup time at new client sites.

timeline.text: Joined LifeMD as a Senior Full-Stack Node Engineer.
Joined Getac as a Software Developer.
Started as a Field Technician at BrooksNetworks.
